@jordan-ae when you claim on mobile (or at least the claim in the screenshot):
1. Does it prompt you to connect your wallet?
2. Does it prompt you to confirm or sign any transaction via a wallet popup/notification/modal?
3. Do you see any notifications at all or just "Claiming..."
4. Are you an IOS or Android user?
5. Is that Brave browser you are using?
^ lmao wtf, the bot just took it upon itself to randomly kick Jordan? 😂

Is your issue due to the fact you have no gas to make the initial claim transaction? Do you have any funds in your wallet?
- https://faucet.gnosischain.com/
That should give you enough to cover gas. There is a UBQ faucet for this scenario but I don't think it's fully implemented by the looks of it
![image](https://github.com/ubiquity/pay.ubq.fi/assets/106303466/809932b9-1935-4162-b1b0-db41aa0ccf49)
It should have kicked me and you from a couple of issue for inactivity or at least notified us but it didn't and I was wondering why but looks like it realised idk 😂

I knew it because I was able to reproduce it locally but that's good
<hr/>
Do you know how to bridge to another chain and off-ramp?
I use [Connext](https://bridge.connext.network/DAI-from-gnosis-to-polygon) to bridge to polygon then off-ramp to a cex.
I've used it since I started contributing and haven't had any issues with it. You will always have to "bump" the relay fee which is always miniscule but it's guaranteed so you'll need a little extra XDAI than the original tx to bridge. No guarantees about it other than the tx's I've put through it.
<hr/>
I've always felt that some sort of welcome doc should be made that shows how various people bridge and off-ramp.
How does everyone else do it? Do you bridge or just straight to CEX or what?
